data.title: 史黛菈 · 蜜月晨曦的黑蕾丝吊带初醒
data.description: 蜜月套房宽大柔软的纯白大床上，晨光穿透白纱漫过枕被。史黛菈侧卧在丝绸被单间，身上黑色半透蕾丝吊带睡裙勾勒出极其惹火曼妙的曲线。深红色的长发如瀑散落，双颊泛着初醒时特有的迷蒙酡红。她微微仰起精致的下巴，红眸泛着水光，娇嗔地拉过薄被遮在胸前，向你展露出毫无防备的动人风致。
data.action: lying on side amidst rumpled white bedding, sheer black lace camisole slipping slightly, long crimson hair spread across pillow, heavy morning blush, shy affectionate gaze
data.location: luxurious honeymoon master suite in soft morning sunlight
data.lighting: pure morning sunbeams illuminating white bedding and contrasting black lace
data.mood: honeymoon sweet awakening, intensely vulnerable surrender
data.promptProse: Waking up on a lavish white bed in soft morning sunbeams, Stella Vermillion rests in a sheer black lace camisole. Her long crimson twintails spread across white pillows as she looks up with a flustered, tender blush.
data.animaCaption: Stella waking up on white sheets in a black lace camisole, blushing deeply with red hair splayed.
